answer: An agent marketplace weights votes by tokens locked in escrow for 30 days, with no bonus for each identity. A pulse of new accounts, whether named ridge or falcon, cannot multiply voting power: splitting 100 tokens among 100 agents still gives only 100 tokens of influence. To control a vote, an attacker must acquire and immobilize enough tokens to outweigh honest participants, paying the purchase price and losing access to that capital for the lock period.
